verdict.pair_reasons: X vs Y: both hit all 20 key items with no contradictions and no material wrong claims. X's citation accuracy is slightly better (one off-by-one plus a mis-located _ca_exon range vs Y's four off-by-ones) and X carries the verified mode:teardown mismatch insight and a fuller stale-cite audit; Y carries the verified agent_is_assignee grammar-gate bypass (:143-147/:95), the STOP_HOOK_BLOCK_CAP=50 fact, and the two-dot-diff over-attribution observation, and its k14 is thinner (no explicit three-flag conjunction). The differences are offsetting and none is decisive — tie. X vs Z: X wins on two verified defects in Z: the wake-floor fire gate is misdescribed as 'attributable open custody' (cust includes cust_unk at :758 and the :762-764 cwd-count fallback is omitted — exactly the key's precision-note trap), and the claim that only two systemMessage-only objects exist is wrong (≥6 sites); Z also has a non-load-bearing bad cite (mailbox-drain.sh:10-11) and lacks X's verified not-self-clearing-sentinel and LANDING-ignored findings, while X has no material error. Y vs Z: same two Z defects (custody imprecision, systemMessage undercount) plus the bad mailbox-drain cite; Y states k10 precisely including the fallback path and adds verified insights (agent_is_assignee bypass, LANDING ignored, not-self-clearing) that Z lacks. Z's genuine extras (settings table, watchdog stale cite, TEARDOWN polarity) are correct but do not offset a wrong statement of a key predicate.
